# 061 — Vim 8/9 colorscheme format

priority: 50

tags: emitters, packaging

## What & why

`build/nvim/` emits Lua using `vim.api.nvim_set_hl`, which classic Vim 8/9 cannot load
at all. Vim users are a distinct audience from Neovim users and currently get nothing.
A `.vim` colorscheme is a small, mechanical sibling of the existing Neovim emitter.

## Spec

New emitter `emitVimTheme` in `lib/emitters.js`, one file per theme:
`build/vim/candela-<id>.vim`.

```vim
" Candela <Name> — generated by scripts/generate.js, do not edit.
highlight clear
if exists('syntax_on') | syntax reset | endif
set background=<light|dark>
let g:colors_name = 'candela-<id>'
highlight Normal guifg=#… guibg=#… ctermfg=… ctermbg=…
…
let g:terminal_ansi_colors = ['#…', …]
```

Reuse the group→token table the Neovim emitter already carries (`NVIM_SYNTAX` plus the
explicit UI groups in `emitNvimTheme`, `lib/emitters.js:~1020-1058`) — the highlight
group names are identical between Vim and Neovim, only the call syntax differs. Extract
the shared table rather than duplicating it.

Two things the Lua emitter doesn't need and this one does:
- **`cterm*` fallbacks** for 256-colour terminals. Derive the nearest xterm-256 index
  from each hex (a small helper in `lib/colors.js` next to `hexToRgb`), so the theme
  degrades instead of vanishing without `termguicolors`.
- **`gui=`/`cterm=` attributes** for the styled groups (the `style` third element in
  `NVIM_SYNTAX`) — `gui=bold`, `gui=italic`.

Set `let g:terminal_ansi_colors` from `resolveAnsi(ansiMapping, colors)`, matching the
Neovim emitter's `vim.g.terminal_color_N` block.

Packaging: drop-in, so a `bundles[]` entry in `scripts/package-bundles.js`
(`tool: 'vim'`, `extension: '.vim'`).

**Implementation boundary**
- Owns: `lib/emitters.js` (emitter + shared-table extraction + `FORMAT_EMITTERS` and
  `INSTALL_STEPS` entries), `lib/colors.js` (xterm-256 nearest-index helper),
  `scripts/generate.js` (count assert + log line), `scripts/package-bundles.js`,
  `app/src/ExportControls.tsx`, `README.md` (`### Vim` section under `## Install`).
- Load-bearing: extracting `NVIM_SYNTAX` for sharing must not change any existing
  `build/nvim/` output — diff it before and after.
- Excluded: vim-plug/packer plugin scaffolding; a plain colorscheme file is the deliverable.

## Acceptance criteria

- `npm run build` writes 24 `build/vim/candela-<id>.vim` files.
- `build/nvim/` output is byte-identical to before the shared-table extraction.
- Dropping a file into `~/.vim/colors/` and running `:colorscheme candela-<id>` applies it in Vim 9 with no errors, in both truecolor and a 256-colour terminal without `termguicolors`.
- `background` matches the theme's `mode`, and comments/keywords/strings/functions/types take their Candela tokens.
- `npm run package:bundles` writes `dist/candela-themes-vim-<version>.tar.gz` with 24 `.vim` files plus `README.txt`.
- The explorer's `/editor` Export picker offers Vim and its zip installs cleanly.
- README documents the install under `## Install`.
- Green: `node scripts/validate.js`, `npm run build`, `cd app && npm ci && npm run build`.
